newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan real estate shares up on investor optimism.
newsitem.headline: Japan real estate shares up on investor optimism.

text.p: Shares in the Japanese real estate sector were higher in the Wednesday afternoon session on investor optimism that the property market was on the road to recovery.
The sector was at the top of the list of gaining sectors.
By 0434 GMT, Mitsubishi Estate Co Ltd had sailed past its high for the calendar year to stand 30 yen higher at 1,570. Mitsui Fudosan Co Ltd added 40 yen to 1,490, renewing its yearly high.

"Vague hopes of improving land liquidity and a recovery in land prices are lifting the sector," a broker at a medium-sized brokerage said. "The sector has been sold off heavily in recent months and its recovery is encouraging for the market in general."
Brokers added that apart from U.S. hedge funds, some domestic institutional investors were showing interest in Mitsubishi Estate.
